scenarios.description: For an Index in Section 4.1, the adjusted return version is calculated from the previous Calculation Day using the underlying index level ratio and subtracting the synthetic dividend term over 360 days.
The adjusted return version is calculated from the NTR Index version, but the decrement is 6% per annum instead of 5% per annum.
A Section 4.1 Index is calculated according to the standard index formula, but the price of one Index Component is quoted in a different currency and no currency conversion is taken into account.
A dividend is paid by an Index Component, but it is reinvested at the close of the effective date rather than at the opening of that date.
